rationale: 20261216090000_governed_engineering_knowledge.sql redefines retrieve_kb_context (and mentions kb_document_classes / kb_claim_types) to add an opt-in governed-source overlay on the canonical Reliability KB. permitted_claims, redistributable and the session gate (auth.uid() then app_current_org(), else the service-role org argument) are preserved. Tenant chunks without a governed source remain retrievable so C2.15 kb_ingest_document stays live. Tenant chunks attached to a governed source are returned only when that source is approved and not superseded. Shared/public corpus visibility is unchanged. Knowledge approval writes only engineering_knowledge_sources.review_state — it does not authorize operational work. The digest move is the retrieval/governance overlay, not a loosening of claim-type standing.
